1: Faith walks forward before the path is fully visible.
2: Courage begins where comfort stops being your master.
3: Trust in God gives strength to take the next right step.
4: Fear predicts collapse, but faith remembers who holds you.
5: A brave heart is often just a surrendered heart in motion.
6: God does not need your certainty before He can use your obedience.
7: Faith is not denial of danger; it is confidence in God's rule over it.
8: Courage grows every time you obey while still shaking.
9: What God calls you to face, He also strengthens you to endure.
10: The size of the storm does not change the authority of Christ.
11: Faith keeps moving when sight has run out of answers.
12: Bold obedience is often the doorway to deeper trust.
